summary: The note describes how local entrepreneurs are increasingly forming partnerships, spurred by the Local Business Growth Act (September 12, 2023) and supported by the Entrepreneurial Resource Center, the ConnectLocal app and the LEMP mentorship program. It gives examples of collaborations in tech, food, retail and beauty, and notes that coalitions will present case studies at the International Summit on Local Economies on March 3, 2024.
one_line: Local policy, resource centers, apps and mentorship are driving partnerships among local entrepreneurs, with examples across tech, food, retail and beauty sectors.
key_facts: The Local Business Growth Act began on September 12, 2023, offering tax incentives for shared initiatives and streamlined permit processes for partner-driven endeavors.
Councilwoman Jane Rodríguez, chair of the Small Business Committee, said the aim is an ecosystem where collaboration is "the cornerstone of innovation and success."
On October 5, 2023, InnoTech Solutions and CyberGuard Synergy announced a joint venture to develop cybersecurity software for small businesses; their founders are Gregory Chen and Aisha Thompson.
On November 22, 2023, farm-to-table restaurant Greenplate partnered with organic farm Harvest Bounty to source seasonal produce and co-host monthly community events on sustainable eating.
Bean There (coffee shop chain) and Reading Haven (bookstore) run the 'Brews and Books' joint marketing initiative, which as of December 15, 2023 had increased foot traffic and sales.
EcoGlam and Clean Essence launched a pop-up boutique on January 28, 2024, focusing on eco-conscious beauty and wellness products and addressing the problem of high retail rents.
The Entrepreneurial Resource Center (ERC) opened on September 19, 2023, and offers workshops, networking events and roundtables promoting cooperative efforts.
Emily Nguyen, an ERC community facilitator, said sharing knowledge empowers local businesses to tackle common challenges and mitigate risks.
The ConnectLocal app launched on September 30, 2023, letting entrepreneurs pitch ideas, seek partners and manage collaborative projects locally.
Tech entrepreneur Marcus Li called ConnectLocal "a game-changer for fostering local business relationships."
The Local Entrepreneur Mentorship and Partnering (LEMP) initiative launched on October 14, 2023, pairing seasoned business owners with budding entrepreneurs; its director is Samuel Hayes.
The International Summit on Local Economies is scheduled for March 3, 2024, where local business coalitions will present case studies of collaborative success.
